title: Hotel check-in
instructions: David otele giriş yapıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; resepsiyonist bir bilgiyi yanlış söylüyor, düzeltmeye dikkat et.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Good evening, welcome to the Blue Sea Hotel.

script.speaker: david
script.text: Good evening. I have a reservation. My name is David Clark.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Let me see. Yes, Mister Clark. A double room for three nights.

script.speaker: david
script.text: No, sorry, it's for four nights. I leave on Sunday.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Oh, you're right. Four nights, from Wednesday to Sunday.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Your room is number two hundred and fifteen, on the second floor.

script.speaker: david
script.text: Thank you. What time is breakfast?

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Breakfast is from seven to ten o'clock in the restaurant, next to the lift.

script.speaker: david
script.text: Great. Is there a swimming pool?

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Yes, there is. It's open from nine in the morning to eight in the evening.

script.speaker: david
script.text: And is there wifi in the room?

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Yes. The password is on the card with your key.

questions.prompt: How many nights is David staying?
questions.feedback: Resepsiyonist önce üç gece (three nights) diyor ama David düzeltiyor: dört gece (four nights).
questions.evidence: No, sorry, it's for four nights.

questions.feedback: Oda numarası 215 (two hundred and fifteen). "Fifteen" ile "fifty" karışmasın.
questions.evidence: Your room is number two hundred and fifteen

questions.feedback: Restoran asansörün yanında (next to the lift). İkinci kat David'in odasının katı.
questions.evidence: in the restaurant, next to the lift.

options: on the card with the key
questions.feedback: Şifre anahtarla birlikte verilen kartın üstünde.
questions.evidence: The password is on the card with your key.
